# Wok

> Rust Nostr relay components and a standalone members-only relay daemon for self-hosted groups.

## Documentation

- [Rust components and daemon](https://github.com/forgesworn/wok/blob/main/README.md): Storage, websocket handling, installation and operator setup.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/wok): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
